manifest.name: m3u Converter
m3u.intro: Converts m3u playlists (EXTINF) into the box's WebTV list format (webtv_usr.xml). Saved on the box, it can join the WebTV sources right away.
m3u.heading: m3u to WebTV list
m3u.title: Title
m3u.none: No stream found: the text holds no address
m3u.no_dir: The box names no folder for its WebTV lists
m3u.source_fail: but not taken into the WebTV sources
m3u.add_to_sources: and add it to the WebTV sources
m3u.replace_text: There is a file of this name on the box already:
m3u.source_added: added to the WebTV sources, the channel lists are read again
m3u.source_known: already one of the WebTV sources, the channel lists are read again
m3u.tip_convert: Turn the list into the format of the box
m3u.tip_download: Save the result as a file on this computer
m3u.tip_save_box: Save the result on the box as a WebTV list
m3u.tip_add_source: Enter the list as a WebTV source of the box as well
